# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  CinaVault Premium — All-in-One Deploy Script
#  Run: Right-click this file > Rename to .ps1 > Run with PowerShell
#  
#  This script will:
#  1. Extract all 48 project files to your machine
#  2. Push to your GitHub repository (CinaVault-Premium)
#  3. Build the Windows installer (NSIS + MSI)
#  4. Copy the installer to Desktop\CinaVault Builds
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "  ╔════════════════════════════════════════════════╗" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  ║  CinaVault Premium — All-in-One Deploy         ║" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  ║  Tauri v2 + Rust + React/TypeScript             ║" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  ║  Public Beta 1 — Build v109 Rewrite             ║" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  ╚════════════════════════════════════════════════╝" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

# ---- Configuration ----
$ProjectDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\CinaVault\cinavault-premium"
$DesktopBuilds = "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\CinaVault Builds"
$GithubRepo = "https://github.com/johngraven75/CinaVault-Premium.git"
$Branch = "tauri-premium"

# ---- Extract project files ----
Write-Host "[1/5] Extracting 48 project files..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

if (-not (Test-Path $ProjectDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ProjectDir -Force | Out-Null }

$files = @{

  "postcss.config.js" = "ZXhwb3J0IGRlZmF1bHQgewogIHBsdWdpbnM6IHsKICAgIHRhaWx3aW5kY3NzOiB7fSwKICAgIGF1dG9wcmVmaXhlcjoge30sCiAgfSwKfTsK"
  "tailwind.config.js" = ""
  "build-installer.bat" = ""
  "deploy.ps1" = ""
  "README.md" = ""
  "tsconfig.node.json" = "ewogICJjb21waWxlck9wdGlvbnMiOiB7CiAgICAiY29tcG9zaXRlIjogdHJ1ZSwKICAgICJza2lwTGliQ2hlY2siOiB0cnVlLAogICAgIm1vZHVsZSI6ICJFU05leHQiLAogICAgIm1vZHVsZVJlc29sdXRpb24iOiAiYnVuZGxlciIsCiAgICAiYWxsb3dTeW50aGV0aWNEZWZhdWx0SW1wb3J0cyI6IHRydWUKICB9LAogICJpbmNsdWRlIjogWyJ2aXRlLmNvbmZpZy50cyJdCn0K"
  "package.json" = ""
  "tsconfig.json" = ""
  "index.html" = ""
  "vite.config.ts" = ""
  ".gitignore" = "bm9kZV9tb2R1bGVzLwpkaXN0Lwp0YXJnZXQvCioubG9nCi5EU19TdG9yZQpUaHVtYnMuZGIK"
  "src-tauri/Cargo.toml" = ""
  "src-tauri/build.rs" = "Zm4gbWFpbigpIHsKICAgIHRhdXJpX2J1aWxkOjpidWlsZCgpCn0K"
  "src-tauri/tauri.conf.json" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/iptv.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/downloads.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/duplicates.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/ai.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/chapters.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/db.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/player.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/jellyfin.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/main.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/plugins.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/vpn.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/metadata.rs" = ""
  "src-tauri/src/scanner.rs" = ""
  "src/themes.ts" = ""
  "src/App.tsx" = ""
  "src/main.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/Header.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/Sidebar.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/effects/AIVisualizer.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/effects/ParticleField.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/HomeTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/AdvancedTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/AIDiagnosticsTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/ServerTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/DownloadsTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/SecurityTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/MediaSourcesTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/CloudNASTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/LiveTVTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/PluginsTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/components/tabs/SettingsTab.tsx" = ""
  "src/store/appStore.ts" = ""
  "src/styles/index.css" = ""
  ".github/workflows/build-windows.yml" = ""
}

foreach ($entry in $files.GetEnumerator()) {
    $filePath = Join-Path $ProjectDir ($entry.Key -replace '/', '\')
    $dir = Split-Path $filePath -Parent
    if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    $bytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($entry.Value)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($filePath, $bytes)
}
Write-Host "  Extracted $($files.Count) files to $ProjectDir" -ForegroundColor Green

# ---- Check prerequisites ----
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[2/5] Checking prerequisites..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

$hasNode = Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$hasCargo = Get-Command cargo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$hasGit = Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

if (-not $hasNode) {
    Write-Host "  [WARN] Node.js not found. Install from https://nodejs.org/" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "  Install Node.js 20 LTS, then re-run this script." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  Project files have been extracted to: $ProjectDir" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "  You can manually build later with: npm install && npm run tauri build" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    pause; exit 1
}
Write-Host "  Node.js: $(node --version)" -ForegroundColor Green

if (-not $hasCargo) {
    Write-Host "  [WARN] Rust/Cargo not found. Install from https://rustup.rs/" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "  Install Rust, then re-run this script." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  Project files have been extracted to: $ProjectDir" -ForegroundColor Green
    pause; exit 1
}
Write-Host "  Cargo: $(cargo --version)" -ForegroundColor Green

if ($hasGit) {
    Write-Host "  Git: $(git --version)" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "  [WARN] Git not found — GitHub push will be skipped" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

# ---- Push to GitHub ----
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[3/5] Pushing to GitHub..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

if ($hasGit) {
    Set-Location $ProjectDir
    if (-not (Test-Path ".git")) {
        git init
        git remote add origin $GithubRepo
    }
    git checkout -B $Branch
    git add -A
    git commit -m "CinaVault Premium - Tauri v2 Rewrite (Public Beta 1)"
    git push -u origin $Branch --force 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
        Write-Host "  Pushed to $GithubRepo (branch: $Branch)" -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Host "  [WARN] Push failed — you may need to authenticate with: git push -u origin $Branch" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "  [SKIP] Git not installed" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

# ---- Build installer ----
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[4/5] Building CinaVault Premium installer..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "       First build takes 5-10 minutes (compiling Rust)..." -ForegroundColor DarkGray

Set-Location $ProjectDir
npm install
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host "  [ERROR] npm install failed" -ForegroundColor Red; pause; exit 1 }

# Install Tauri CLI if needed
cargo install tauri-cli --version "^2.0" 2>$null

npm run tauri build
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "  [ERROR] Build failed. Check Rust and Node.js versions." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "  Project files are at: $ProjectDir" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    pause; exit 1
}

# ---- Copy to Desktop ----
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[5/5] Copying installer to Desktop..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

if (-not (Test-Path $DesktopBuilds)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DesktopBuilds -Force | Out-Null }

$nsisFiles = Get-ChildItem "src-tauri\target\release\bundle\nsis\*.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$msiFiles = Get-ChildItem "src-tauri\target\release\bundle\msi\*.msi" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

foreach ($f in $nsisFiles) {
    Copy-Item $f.FullName $DesktopBuilds -Force
    Write-Host "  Copied: $($f.Name)" -ForegroundColor Green
}
foreach ($f in $msiFiles) {
    Copy-Item $f.FullName $DesktopBuilds -Force
    Write-Host "  Copied: $($f.Name)" -ForegroundColor Green
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "  ════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "   DEPLOY COMPLETE!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "   Project:    $ProjectDir" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "   Installers: $DesktopBuilds" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "   GitHub:     $GithubRepo ($Branch)" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  ════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""
pause
